title: The Goat Who Stood Tall
summary: A young goat must gather courage to cross a roaring stream and deliver important news to the mountain village, learning that true heroes face their fears.

pages.text: In a green meadow by a deep stream lived a young goat named Lee.
pages.scene: A small gray goat standing in a sunny field near rushing water

pages.text: Lee loved to eat the sweet grass and play with his goat friends.
pages.scene: Goat happily grazing with other goats in peaceful routine

pages.text: One afternoon, a worried goose flew down and said, "Help! The rain has come!"
pages.scene: A frightened goose landing, signaling urgent danger

pages.text: "The stream is deep and will float things away!" cried the goose.
pages.scene: Stream swelling dangerously with water flowing fast

pages.text: "Lee, you must go to the hill town and tell them to stay!"
pages.scene: Goose desperately asking Lee to make a dangerous journey

pages.text: Lee's heart beat fast as he looked at the wild water.
pages.scene: Young goat staring anxiously at the roaring stream

pages.text: "I am small," he said, "but I will be strong and brave."
pages.scene: Lee taking a deep breath and building his courage

pages.text: Lee stepped into the stream and felt the cold, swift flow.
pages.scene: Goat carefully wading through rushing water

pages.text: The water pushed him, but he held tight and did not float away.
pages.scene: Lee struggling but determinedly crossing the stream

pages.text: He climbed up the steep path to the town.
pages.scene: Goat climbing steadily up the hillside toward village

pages.text: "Rain is coming! Stay high!" he cried to each door.
pages.scene: Lee going house to house, warning villagers

pages.text: The people heard Lee and moved their things to safe ground.
pages.scene: Villagers listening to Lee and preparing for danger

pages.text: When the flood passed, the town was safe because of Lee!
pages.scene: Village safe after the waters recede

pages.text: Lee learned that being a hero is not about being big.
pages.scene: Lee standing tall, recognized by the grateful villagers

pages.text: It is about being brave enough to try when others need you.
pages.scene: Lee returning home as a true hero
Lee with all the animals, celebrated for bravery
